chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Al-Husayn ibn Khalid who said: I said to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Rida (peace be upon him)

'The people are saying that the one who does not eat meat for three days, his character/mannerisms would worsen.' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'They are lying. But the one who does not eat meat for forty days, his character/mannerisms and his body will change, and that is due to the transference of the seed in the span of forty days.'

key_terms.النُّطْفَةِ: the seed (referring to seminal fluid/embryonic development)

ai.seo_question: How long does one need to abstain from meat for their character and body to change according to Imam Al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) refutes the popular notion that a three-day meat abstinence alters character, establishing a forty-day period for significant physical and moral transformation. This duration is theologically linked to the concept of *intiqal al-nutfah* (the transition of the seed), mirroring the embryonic development phase described in Shia physiological traditions. The hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on gradual bodily purification (*tazkiyah*) as a prerequisite for spiritual refinement.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Al Husayn Bin Khalid who said, 
‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> that, ‘

The people are saying that the one who does not eat the meat for thirty days, his mannerisms would worsen’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They are lying, but the one who does not eat the meat for forty days, his mannerisms would change, and his body (as well), and that is the transference of the seed in a measurement of forty days’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from al-Husayn ibn Khalid who has said the following: “I once said to abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘

People say that if one does not eat meat for three days his manners change to worse.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘They have spoken lies. However, one who does not eat meat for forty days his manners change and it is because the seed (sperm) transfers (from one stage of development to another) within the duration of forty days.”
